initial_plan.can_answer: yes: the dataset has a pedestrian-fatality count for each police-reported motor vehicle crash, so annual totals can be calculated for the years represented; coverage of 2025 and missing count values will be checked before making the final claim
initial_plan.metric: sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed, interpreted as pedestrian deaths recorded in police-reported motor vehicle crashes
initial_plan.denominator: none; this is a count, not a rate
initial_plan.population: all crash records with a valid crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
initial_plan.filters: crash_date year is 2013–2025; no other filters

data_check_decisions.facts: The selected population contains 2,132,218 crash records. Each year 2013–2025 has recorded dates from January 1 through December 31, including 85,546 records in 2025. Within every year, crash_date and number_of_pedestrians_killed are missing in 0 rows.
data_check_decisions.meaning: The observed dates span the full calendar year in every requested year, and no in-scope crash record lacks the pedestrian-fatality count. Thus no in-scope rows are dropped or handled differently for the annual totals. The target population remains all police-reported crash records with crash dates in 2013–2025; records with dates outside that range are outside the population by design.
data_check_decisions.decisions: Keep all in-scope records and disclose that the measure covers police-reported crashes only. There are no missing outcome rows to exclude or place in a separate group.

final_plan.can_answer: yes, for pedestrian deaths recorded in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes in each requested calendar year
final_plan.metric: annual sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed; each unit is one pedestrian death recorded in the crash data
final_plan.denominator: none; annual count, not a rate or share
final_plan.population: all crash records with crash_date in calendar years 2013–2025 inclusive, with each recorded pedestrian death counted
final_plan.filters: crash_date is within 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31 inclusive; no other filters; retain all in-scope rows
final_plan.years: calendar years 2013–2025 inclusive; data check observed crash dates spanning January 1 to December 31 in each year
final_plan.missing_value_handling: The plan-scoped check found 0 missing number_of_pedestrians_killed values in each year, so no rows are excluded or imputed.
final_plan.limitations: This counts pedestrian deaths recorded in police-reported crashes, not all deaths necessarily occurring in NYC traffic; reporting and classification may be incomplete. Dates in the file span all days of each requested calendar year, including 2025.
